About Axulal

Axulal began in 2011 as part of the national Universal Rural Roads Access Program (URRAP). Two engineers and one surveyor, each with more than fifteen years in the industry, founded it. Today it holds a Category-1 Highway and Bridge consultant license from the Federal Ministry of Construction.

We cover the full run of a road or bridge job: study, survey, design, tender documents, construction supervision and contract administration. We use locally available resources and techniques, and we involve the people who will use the road, women and men, young and old, in rural and urban areas alike.

Vision

To push past the default standard of consulting in Ethiopia, and set a new brand for the country through well-studied solutions.

Mission

To deliver quality services that exceed client expectations, through continuous training and innovation.

Led by experience

Our General Manager has more than 17 years in road and infrastructure engineering in Ethiopia.

A team for each job

Every project gets a dedicated team under a senior specialist, with draftsmen and surveyors added as the workload needs.

Three departments

Design, Contract Administration, and Administration and Finance, working under one General Manager.
